content_of_post_to_comment: We decided to show all three of our kids The Princess Bride this weekend and now my six-year-old won’t stop saying, “My name is Inigo Montoya. You killed my father. Prepare to die.”
comment: The funniest part is how kids turn a single dramatic line into a whole identity. Maybe that's why certain films endure: they don't just entertain children, they give them language for imagination.
